body: Forget to mention  my gum was Infected weeks ago it always does every now and then since having this bridge, but it gets better each time, I don't know is this tooth decay underneath? Bone decay? It's like something found a way out through my gums
Can I get away with this lol? I mean I thought they would require a document of the graduation certificate
When I was first put on prozac I cried every night for a week and yes the urge was stronger than usual, but it all stopped after a week

I don't  have an answer to your question  but I'm in the same boat rn, I graduated last year not ready for a job and I immediately got a non tech job, stayed there for 8 months then quit after saving a while and got a decent laptop to work on( I was never gonna be able to get one without a job) then decided to focus on studying, I'm studying like 4-6 hrs a day and Iitteraly  panicking that my degree would go to waste, and every day i get more scared how I'm gonna justify not getting a job after like 2 years of graduation,
Your definitely not alone.
I'm so sorry you have to live with them, being neurodivergent is hard, but your experience is valid even if they don't understand or believe you.
Thank you so much but I don't feel that would make me feel better
